title: 성평등가족부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Designation of Enterprises Subject to Priority Management and Issuance of Mission Notice)
Where the Minister of Gender Equality and Family designates an enterprise subject to priority management pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and Article 10 of the Decree, the Minister shall without delay send the Notice of Designation as an Enterprise Subject to Priority Management and Mission Notice in attached Form 1 to the head of the enterprise and shall record and manage it in the Register of Designated Enterprises Subject to Priority Management in attached Form 2. The same shall apply where the designation is changed. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
